paper.title_en: Linear monitoring-feedback Model for Linearized gravity
paper.abstract_en: Whether gravity has quantum degrees of freedom is a question of fundamental importance. We formulate a linear monitoring-feedback framework for gravitational interactions that includes local classical-record models of semiclassical gravity and, when quantum resources are supplied in correlated ancilla inputs, can reproduce linearized quantum-gravity dynamics. Auxiliary systems monitor the positions of massive bodies, and their records are fed back through a chosen gravitational response kernel. At the level of linear input-output theory, this construction makes the deterministic response explicit while exposing the force noise and correlations associated with the auxiliary sector. We organize the allowed ancilla correlations into three regimes. In Regime-I, independent ancillas have unsqueezed, uncorrelated sensing and back-action quadratures. A single object then has a minimum classical-gravity noise (CGN), S_F^min = 2 hbar M Omega_SN^2, where Omega_SN is the Schrodinger-Newton frequency set by the microscopic mass distribution. In Regime-II, arbitrary local sensing--back-action correlations are allowed, but the ancillas associated with different objects remain independent. The single-object CGN is then unrestricted, while the joint force-noise matrix obeys a determinant bound that is equivalent to the local classical-channel/no-entanglement bound. In Regime-III, cross-object correlations and a common nonlocal mediator are allowed. The commuting force noises can then be jointly squeezed, entanglement between the masses can occur, and--with a suitable retarded response and input state--the monitoring-feedback system can reproduce the noise and commutators of linearized quantum gravity, including non-Markovian quantum fluctuations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以线性输入-输出理论与监测-反馈框架研究半经典引力与线性化量子引力的噪声及对易关系，属于引力理论基础的量子性质问题；理论构建清晰，分三种情形系统分析，并提出可区分的经典与量子噪声界限，具有较高理论深度与新颖性。虽涉及修改引力的噪声模型，但核心是引力理论基础，故归入 general_relativity_foundations。
decision.title_zh: 线性化引力的线性监测-反馈模型
decision.abstract_zh: 引力是否具有量子自由度是一个具有根本重要性的问题。我们为引力相互作用构建了一个线性监测-反馈框架，该框架包含半经典引力的局域经典记录模型，并且在提供相关的辅助（ancilla）量子输入时，能够重现线性化量子引力动力学。辅助系统监测大质量物体的位置，其记录通过选定的引力响应核进行反馈。在线性输入-输出理论的层面上，这一构造使确定性响应显式化，同时揭示与辅助部分相关的力噪声和关联。我们将允许的辅助关联组织为三种情形。在情形I中，独立的辅助系统具有未压缩、无关联的探测与反作用正交分量。此时单个物体具有最小经典引力噪声（CGN），S_F^min = 2 hbar M Omega_SN^2，其中 Omega_SN 是由微观质量分布决定的薛定谔-牛顿频率。在情形II中，允许任意局域的探测-反作用关联，但与不同物体相关的辅助系统仍保持独立。此时单物体的 CGN 不受限制，而联合力噪声矩阵服从一个行列式界，该界等价于局域经典信道/无纠缠界。在情形III中，允许跨物体关联以及一个共同的非局域媒介。此时可交换的力噪声可以被联合压缩，质量之间可以发生纠缠，并且在适当的延迟响应和输入态下，监测-反馈系统能够重现线性化量子引力的噪声与对易关系，包括非马尔可夫量子涨落。
